description: Warrior Talents emphasize durability, direct confrontation, battlefield control, and protecting allies.

talents.name: Martial Prowess
effect: Choose one Weapon Attack when acquiring Rank I.
Every Rank: Increase that Attack's Attacks by 1, or improve its Hit by 1 step; and improve one Skill by 1 step.
This Attack must be different from the Attack improved through generic Prowess. All additional Ranks continue improving the selected Attack.

talents.name: Hold Fast
talents.effect: When targeted by an Attack, gain Tough 1 against that Attack.

talents.name: Press Forward
talents.effect: Choose yourself or one friendly Unit within Short Range. Roll Body + Athletics. Move the chosen Unit up to X inches, where X equals the number of successes. This movement cannot enter Engagement.

talents.name: Guarded Advance
talents.effect: Choose yourself or one friendly Unit within Short Range. Move the selected Unit up to 2". It gains Tough 1 against the next ranged Attack targeting it this Round. This movement cannot enter Engagement.

talents.name: Extended Shot
talents.effect: Choose one non-Firearm ranged Weapon Attack. Increase its Range by 2" per Rank.

talents.name: Counterattack
talents.effect: After surviving an Melee Attack, gain +1 Attack die on your next Melee Weapon Attack against the attacker. This bonus expires at the end of your next Combat activation.

talents.name: Bodyguard
talents.effect: When an allied Unit within 2" is targeted by an Attack or Charge, you may move up to 2" toward that ally. Roll Body + Athletics. After the incoming Hits or Charge Impact are determined, but before Saves, redirect up to X Hits to yourself, where X equals the number of successes. Resolve your own Saves against the redirected Hits. Hits not redirected remain allocated to the original target. A redirected Hit cannot be redirected again.

talents.name: Challenge
talents.effect: Choose one enemy Unit within Short Range. Until the end of the Round, that Unit worsens its Hit by 1 step when attacking another target, provided you are a legal target for its Attack.

talents.name: Driving Blow
talents.effect: After your Melee Weapon Attack deals Damage to an enemy, roll Body + Athletics. If the Check generates at least one success, push the target directly away up to X inches, where X is the highest die rolled. You may follow the target by up to 2". This is forced movement. The follow-up movement does not count as Disengaging.

talents.name: Breakthrough
talents.effect: After defeating an enemy Unit in Engagement, move up to 2". This movement may enter Engagement with another enemy.

talents.name: Dig In
talents.effect: If you did not Move during the Movement Phase, improve Armor by 1 step against ranged Attacks until your next Movement activation.

talents.name: Mighty Impact
talents.effect: Gain Impact X, where X equals the Rank of Mighty Impact. This adds X Hits to the normal highest-die Charge Impact pool following a successful Charge; Armor and Ward apply, but Evade does not.

talents.name: Brace Training
talents.effect: When receiving a Charge, gain Brace 1 against that Charge if you did not voluntarily Move during the preceding Movement Phase. Stacks with applicable Brace X.

talents.name: Unyielding
talents.effect: When Damage from an incoming Attack against you is about to be applied, after Saves have been resolved, roll Body + Survival. Reduce the Damage of up to X unsaved Hits by 1 each, to a minimum of 0, where X equals the number of successes.

talents.name: Last Stand
talents.effect: When you would become Defeated, remain with accumulated Damage equal to one less than your Wounds characteristic instead.
